title: What's New in AL:  Embedding Resources in Applications (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Overview of the resources folder structure

features.name: Embedding resources in applications
features.description: New capability to ship resources with your application by including them in a resources folder within the app file, allowing developers to embed CSV data, images, and other files.
caveats: Not available for use at time of video

features.name: get resource function
features.description: New function in the NavAdType that retrieves a resource by file name and relative path from the resources folder, placing it into a specified stream.

features.name: Multiple resource folders
features.description: Ability to specify multiple resource folders within an extension, such as separate folders for images and data files.
caveats: Resource names including paths must be unique across all folders in the extension

features.name: Resource size limitations
features.description: Maximum resource size is 1,024 kilobytes, maximum total resources per extension is 16 megabytes, and maximum number of resources per extension is 256.

features.name: Read-only resources
features.description: Resources embedded in an extension are read-only because app packages cannot be altered after being shipped.
caveats: Resources cannot be modified after deployment
Resources only available from owning extension

quotes.text: I have some code to show you and it's going to be really exciting but first I have to say you can't use it
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the feature is in preview status and not yet available for use.

quotes.text: resources in applications meaning you can ship your resources with your application get the resource for that specific application for that specific version
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core purpose and capability of embedding resources with app deployment.

quotes.text: the resource name including the path relative to the resource folder must be unique within the extension
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical constraint for multi-folder configurations that developers must follow.

quotes.text: the resources are only only available from the extension that owns the resource
quotes.why_it_matters: Only the owning extension can access its resources, so sharing them with other extensions needs custom code.

quotes.text: if your file extensions are not valid on the server that you want to deploy it to all the mime types checks will fail
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that the server checks embedded resources at publish time and can block the app from being deployed.
